questions.question_text: Goods worth Rs 5,000 are purchased on credit from Ravi. The accounts affected and their nature are:
Machinery bought for cash Rs 40,000. The entry is:
questions.explanation: Real account debited, real account credited.

questions.question_text: Goods returned by a customer, Mohan, worth Rs 800. The entry is:
Discount allowed to a customer is a:
options: Liability, credited to the creditors account
Loss to the firm, debited to the discount account
Real asset, debited to the stock account
Gain to the firm, credited to the discount account

questions.question_text: Discount received from a supplier is credited to:
options: Discount received account, a nominal account

questions.question_text: Bad debts written off are debited to:
Interest on capital allowed to the proprietor is:
options: A liability, debited to the capital account
An expense to the business, credited to the capital
An income to the business, credited to profit
An asset, debited to the cash account
questions.explanation: Dr Interest on capital, Cr Capital.

questions.question_text: Cash withdrawn by the owner for private use is debited to:

options: Posting of a wrong amount in one account only
Posting an amount on the wrong side

questions.question_text: A transaction posted twice on the correct sides in both accounts. The trial balance:
options: Shows a difference equal to the amount

questions.question_text: The purchase of Rs 1,500 was debited to the creditor and credited to purchases. The trial balance difference is:
questions.explanation: Both entries reversed: double the amount.

options: Profit and loss account, debit side Rs 5,000

Which of the following is shown on the debit side of a trial balance?
Sales returns (returns inward) appear in the trial balance on the:
Closing stock appears in a trial balance only when:
options: It is shown on the credit side along with the sales
It is shown on the debit side along with the purchases
It is given as an adjustment outside the trial balance, so it is not listed
It is shown on the credit side with the other incomes
questions.explanation: It is dealt with in the final accounts, not the trial balance.

questions.question_text: The single entry system is best described as:
options: A system used mainly by large joint stock companies today
A complete record of both aspects of every transaction made
An incomplete record that mainly keeps personal accounts and cash
A record based on the cost principle of accounting alone

questions.question_text: Under single entry, profit is usually found by the:
options: Trial balance method, after preparing the adjusted ledger
Cash flow method, based on the movement of cash balances
Statement of affairs method, comparing opening and closing capital
Ratio method, based on the gross profit percentage

questions.question_text: Opening capital Rs 1,00,000, closing capital Rs 1,50,000, drawings Rs 20,000, fresh capital Rs 10,000. Profit under single entry is:

options: Recording only one aspect of the transaction
Recording both debit and credit aspects

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements regarding the ledger is true?
options: The ledger is prepared only at year end
The ledger is the book of final entry
The ledger is the book of original entry
The ledger records only cash transactions

questions.question_text: Capital account of a proprietor has a:
Drawings account has a:
options: Credit balance in case of losses
questions.explanation: It is deducted from the capital.

questions.question_text: A bank overdraft has a:
options: Debit balance in the purchases account
Debit balance in the cash book
Credit balance in the debtors' ledger
Credit balance in the cash book bank column

options: Cross-refer an entry between the journal and the ledger
Show the cash balance after each entry is made
Record the date on which the transaction took place

questions.question_text: Posting refers to the process of:
options: Preparing the journal entries from the original vouchers
Transferring entries from the journal to the ledger accounts
Balancing the ledger accounts at the end of a period
Totalling the money columns of the cash book at the end

questions.question_text: Balancing of an account involves:
options: Totalling both sides and finding the difference
Passing a fresh journal entry for each item
Posting the closing figures to the profit account
Closing the account by transferring it to capital

questions.question_text: The balance of an account is described as "balance c/d" when it is on the:
options: Side that is the smaller total
questions.explanation: It is carried down on the smaller side.

questions.question_text: If the total of the debit side of an account is Rs 50,000 and the credit side is Rs 42,000, the balance is Rs 8,000 and appears as:
options: Balance c/d on the credit side
Balance b/d on the credit side
Balance c/d on the debit side
questions.explanation: Credit side is smaller, so the balance is written on it.

questions.question_text: Opening balance of an asset account is shown on the:
The ledger account of sales is closed by transferring it to the:
The ledger account of drawings is closed by transferring to the:

options: Interest received account of the firm
Outstanding salary payable to an employee
Land and buildings account of the firm
questions.explanation: Represents the person to whom it is due.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a real account?
The golden rule for real accounts is:
options: Debit the giver, credit the receiver
Debit what comes in, credit what goes out
Debit expenses and losses, credit incomes and gains
Debit the receiver, credit the giver

options: After posting and balancing the ledger

options: An error, because it should be a debit balance

Omission of a transaction from the books

options: A difference on the debit side

questions.explanation: Wrong amount in the original book.

An increase in income under the modern approach is:

options: The trial balance does not agree

questions.question_text: The books of original entry include:
options: Balance sheet and profit and loss account

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a book of original entry?

options: Cancel each other out, so the trial balance still agrees
Can be discovered only by the statutory auditor
